profile.visual_desc: Muscular humanoid with dark blue fur, wearing a brown loincloth and matching leg wraps. Shown from a rear-isometric perspective.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Blue feline face with piercing yellow eyes and prominent white fangs. Intense, predatory expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Natural claws and fists; uses no held weapons.
profile.step1_ready: Low, rear-isometric crouch facing up-left with fists held near the waist.
profile.step2_windup: Body coils backward as the right fist is drawn toward the shoulder.
profile.step3_impact: Sudden forward lunge; a large, bright yellow energy wedge bursts from the right fist toward the upper-left.
profile.step4_finish: Standing follow-through with arm extended as the golden energy effect dissipates.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy wedge in Frame 4 aligns with the forward punch trajectory originating from the right hand.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation accurately translates reference with correct perspective, consistent anatomy, and properly aligned punch VFX.
